files.rationale: Kept PR A's exact-output "emoji" test (replacing the base's commented-out TODO) and also kept PR B's distinct "emoji error message" crash-check test, both of which pass with the merged invalid_char implementation.

Both sides fixed the same surrogate-pair FIXME in invalid_char; kept PR A's String::get_char-based version (which decodes surrogate pairs, falls back to U+FFFD for malformed or out-of-range offsets, and satisfies both sides' tests) and dropped PR B's now-unused local surrogate helpers to avoid unused-function warnings.
